facelet_order: URFDLB, 9 facelets per face, left-to-right top-to-bottom when viewed from outside the cube
face_layout: positions 0-8 on each face: row0=[0,1,2], row1=[3,4,5], row2=[6,7,8]

corners.description: 8 corner cubies. Facelets listed as [reference, CW1, CW2]. Reference facelet is always on U or D face. CW1 and CW2 follow clockwise order when the corner is viewed from outside the reference (U/D) face.

orientation.twist_0: The U/D-colored sticker of the cubie is at the reference facelet position (on a U or D face)
orientation.twist_1: The U/D-colored sticker is at the CW1 position
orientation.twist_2: The U/D-colored sticker is at the CW2 position

edges.description: 12 edge cubies. Facelets listed as [primary, secondary]. For edges in U/D layers, the primary facelet is on the U or D face. For E-layer edges (FR, FL, BL, BR), the primary facelet is on the F or B face.

orientation.flip_0: The cubie's reference color (U/D for UD-layer edges, F/B for E-layer edges) is at the primary facelet position
orientation.flip_1: The cubie's reference color is at the secondary facelet position

solvability_invariants.corner_twist: Sum of all 8 corner orientations must be 0 mod 3
solvability_invariants.edge_flip: Sum of all 12 edge orientations must be 0 mod 2
solvability_invariants.parity: The parity (sign) of the corner permutation must equal the parity of the edge permutation

algebraic_order.description: The order of a cube state as an element of the Rubik's cube group. Computed via the wreath product structure.
algebraic_order.corner_cycle_order: For a corner cycle of length k with total twist sum s along the cycle: augmented order = k if s mod 3 == 0, else 3k
algebraic_order.edge_cycle_order: For an edge cycle of length k with total flip sum s along the cycle: augmented order = k if s mod 2 == 0, else 2k
algebraic_order.total_order: LCM of all augmented corner cycle orders and all augmented edge cycle orders
